headline: Cyrus and David Cao climb into ARC-2 top 100

sections.text: Cyrus climbed 211 places, from 305th to 94th, at 35.42 (+3.48). David Cao moved 59 places, from 147th to 88th, at 35.97 (+3.19).
Both moves carry their teams from outside the top 100 to inside it on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
